Key presses a special key or key combination in a g3d-termd session, by session
name (agent "helper"'s session is "agent-helper").

Supported keys include:
  Enter, Escape, Tab, Space
  c-c (Ctrl+C), c-d (Ctrl+D), c-z (Ctrl+Z), etc.
  Up, Down, Left, Right
  Home, End, PgUp, PgDn
  F1-F24

Unrecognized multi-character names are typed literally.

Usage:
  agent key <session> <key> [flags]

Examples:
  agent key my-session Enter
  agent key agent-helper c-c
  agent key my-session Escape

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for key

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
